 FILE PHOTO: India’s Lakshya Sen (in pic) will look to extend his 12-match winning streak when he takes on Singapore’s Loh Kean Yew in the Hong Kong Open quarterfinals on Friday.
 | Photo Credit: REUTERS
 India’s star shuttler Lakshya Sen will look to continue his fine form when he meets Singapore’s Loh Kean Yew in the quarterfinals of the ongoing Hong Kong Open 2026 Super 500 tournament on Friday.
 The two players have met 12 times in the past before, with Lakshya having a 7-5 advantage in the head-to-head record. Their most recent meeting took place in the round of 32 at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games in which the Singapore shuttler won 21-12, 15-21, 21-14.
 The Indian has already secured qualification to the season-ending BWF Tour Finals.
 LIVE STREAMING INFO
 When is the Lakshya Sen vs Loh Kean Yew Hong Kong Open 2026 quarterfinal match? 
 The Lakshya Sen vs Loh Kean Yew Hong Kong Open 2026 quarterfinal match will begin around 11 a.m. IST (1:30 p.m. local time) on Court 1 at the Kai Tak Arena on November 20, Friday.
 Where to watch the Lakshya Sen vs Loh Kean Yew Hong Kong Open 2026 quarterfinal match LIVE? 
 The Lakshya Sen vs Loh Kean Yew Hong Kong Open 2026 quarterfinal match will be streamed on the BWF TV YouTube channel. It will also be streamed on the Fancode platform.
